CS 338: Computer Applications in Business: Databases
Description: A user-oriented approach to the management of large collections of data. Methods used for the storage, selection, and presentation of data. Common database management systems.
Requirements: Prereq: One of CS 230, 231, 234, 246/246E, 330; or (AFM 341 and (CS 116 or CS 136 or CS 146)); Antireq: CS 348, 448, MSCI 346; Not open to Honours Computer Science, Honours Data Science (BCS), BCFM, BSE
